name: Sacred Path Feature
summary: Sacred Path Feature Preacher Once per long rest, as an action, up to three allies within 30 ft regain hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier. Flagellant Once per turn, when you are below half hit points, your melee attacks deal +1d8 radiant or fire damage. Purifier Your fire damage ignores resistance, and daemons/corrupted creatures cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn after taking your fire damage.
